👤 Squad & Substitutions
1
Each team plays 5 v 5 — 5 players on pitch at all times. 5v5
2
Substitutions are unlimited — rotate freely all hour. Unlimited
3
Subs only when play stops — after a goal or end of a mini-match.
⚽ How a Matchday Works
4
All 3 teams play every Saturday 6–7PM, 1 hour total.
5
Each mini-match is 7 minutes OR 1 goal — whichever first.
6
Losing team rotates out. Third team comes in. Non-stop for the full hour.
7
Goals totalled per team at end of hour.
8
First to 10 goals wins — OR most goals after 1 hour wins.
🏆 Points System
9
1st — 3 points 3 PTS   2nd — 1 point 1 PT   3rd — 0 points 0 PTS
10
Example: King FC 10, GOAT 7, Empire FC 3 → King FC 3pts · GOAT 1pt · Empire FC 0pts
